content.title: About
content.content: Pickled radishes are fresh radish roots that have been fermented or brined in a vinegar solution with salt, sugar, spices, and sometimes aromatic herbs. They retain a crisp texture and develop a tangy‑sweet flavor typical of many snack foods.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Radishes belong to the Brassicaceae family, making them relatives of cabbage, broccoli, and mustard.
Pickling extends the shelf life of radishes, allowing storage in the refrigerator for several months.
Different cultures have distinct recipes: Japan often uses rice vinegar and sea salt, while Russia commonly adds mustard seeds and dill.
The bright pink color of some pickled radishes can be enhanced with beet juice or food coloring.
Radishes are rich in vitamin C, which remains partially intact after pickling.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Low‑calorie snack
items.content: Radishes are low in calories, making them suitable for weight‑controlled diets.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps maintain satiety.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Phytonutrients in radishes help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports heart health
items.content: Low sodium in homemade brine and the presence of potassium contribute to normal blood pressure.

items.title: Allergy to cruciferous vegetables
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to radishes.

items.title: Salt content
items.content: Pickling brine can be salty; people limiting sodium should monitor portion size.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Improper storage can lead to growth of harmful bacteria. Keep refrigerated and respect the use‑by date.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pickled radishes are served as a snack, added to salads, sandwiches, sushi rolls, vegetarian wraps, or used as a garnish for meat dishes. They can be eaten straight from the jar.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the jar of pickled radishes in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C. After opening, consume within 2–3 weeks. Discard if an off‑odor or mold appears.
